_doc: The Mysterious Figure's visits after the opening scene. Each plays once, when its trigger is met (see FigureVisit). bit: its flag in the player's saved figure scenes. lines: what it says as it arrives. choices: what you can answer, and its reply. end: its parting words before it vanishes. Speakers: figure, action. battle: true ends the talk in a battle against the figure instead of it vanishing (the Eternita Stone trial). A choice with reveal: true tells you its name: from then on it is the Acolyte of the First (its name in every scene, battle and as a recruit). "Mysterious Figure" in any line is replaced by its current name. npc: "last" is the Acolyte of the Last (the Spooky Mysterious Figure until his second visit is over); after: a scene that has to have played first. {name} in a line is replaced by its current name.

reply: So you'll need to be stronger still. Remember me, at least: the Acolyte of the First.
I am but a humble follower of the First, and your personal guide to destiny.
You may call me the Acolyte of the First.

scenes.trigger: a base of yours reaches Level 2
lines: Look at this place. Walls, fires, creatures working side by side.
This is what Serantia looked like, once. Before the Ashes.

reply: The old kingdoms burned their world down reaching for power. The Council saved what it could. It wasn't enough.
Every kingdom that ever stood began as 'just' something.

end: Keep building. But a home is where rebuilding begins, not where it ends. Look beyond your walls.

lines: A Master's Stone. You've earned the respect of one who walks with an influence.
There are twelve influences, and twelve Sovereigns who shaped them. Every stone brings you a little closer to understanding them.

reply: The Twelve Dragons of the Council of Eternita. Look for the old books. They remember more than I'm allowed to say.

choices.text: What if I collect them all?
reply: Then perhaps the First will hear your name.

end: The other Masters are out there, wandering. Find them. Get stronger.

lines: You found one. And you rebuilt it.
The towers were the First Dragon's watchposts, long before the Age of Ashes. While they stood, the world stood with them.

reply: Every tower that rises again is a thread pulling Serantia back together. And something out there can feel it pulling.

choices.text: What was that roar, the day we met?
reply: Something that would rather this world stayed broken. Don't go looking for it. Not yet.

end: There are more towers. Find them, before it does.

scenes.trigger: your first steps in the Nether
lines: Serantia was never just one world. The Sovereigns hid pieces of creation in places like this, where the unworthy wouldn't wander.

reply: More than you'd believe. Some lie beneath your feet. Some beyond the stars. And one waits at the very end of everything.
Horrible places keep the best secrets.

end: Explore it. Carefully. The answers were never kept in one place.

lines: Three towers standing again. The land is changing around them. Can you feel it?
The Council feels it too. They're watching you now.

reply: For you? We'll see. For Serantia, it's the first good thing in a thousand years.
*The Mysterious Figure glances at the sky*
Something old. Something that was cast off and never forgave it. It knows your name now.

end: Get stronger. Find the rest of the towers. We may not have as much time as I hoped.

lines: *The Mysterious Figure studies the stone in your hands*
Do you understand what you're holding? It was cut from the First Dragon's own scales, in the age before ages.
The Masters gave it to you because they believe you're worthy of it. I'm not so easily convinced.

reply: Everyone says that. Few ever are.
From the Masters, perhaps. Not from me.

choices.text: Who are you to judge me?
reply: Someone who has watched a thousand would-be heroes hold that stone. And watched it break them.

end: *The Mysterious Figure draws itself up to its full height. The air turns cold.*
All of you, against me. Hold nothing back. I won't.

scenes.trigger: your third meeting with the Acolyte of the First (the opening scene counts)
lines: *The world darkens. A hooded figure steps out of the shadows*
So you're the one the Acolyte of the First keeps whispering to.
Has he told you what he is? What he really wants? No. He never does.

reply: Someone who's seen what happens to his little helpers. Who I am can wait. What he is can't.
Helping you? He's using you. A tool to stitch the old world back together, every flaw and all.

end: The Acolyte of the First is a liar, and a fraud. He'll walk you to your grave smiling the whole way.
Have you noticed the creatures growing wilder? Angrier? That isn't an accident. It's a promise.

scenes.trigger: a base of yours reaches Level 3 (after his first visit)
lines: *The air turns cold. The {name} is waiting for you*
You didn't listen. Of course you didn't.
Every tower you raise, every wall you build, drags Serantia back toward the mistakes that broke it.
This world must stay in ruin. Only from the ashes can it be reborn correctly. The Last Dragon understands that. Soon everyone will.

reply: I am the Acolyte of the Last. I serve the one the First cast off: the Last Dragon, the King of Chaos.
I am the Acolyte of the Last, and I didn't come to ask. I'll tear down everything you've built, and you along with it.

choices.text: What does the Last Dragon want?
reply: To shed this world like an old skin. Every Enraged beast you meet is one more crack in its shell. My master and I have been busy.
I am his Acolyte. The Acolyte of the Last. Remember it.

end: Keep going, and I will destroy you. Consider this your only warning.

scenes.trigger: 400 different creatures recruited (after his second visit)
lines: Four hundred creatures. Four hundred souls bound to you.
Do you know how many I've driven mad for my master? How many I've Enraged to feed his chaos? More than you'll ever recruit.
You've become exactly what the First wanted. A shepherd for his broken world.
So let's end this. Here. Now.

choices.text: You don't have to do this.
reply: Mercy? From you? The Last Dragon taught me what mercy is worth.

end: *Dark energy crackles around the {name}. Somewhere far away, a dragon roars.*
All of you, against me. When you fall, the chaos will have one more champion.
